title: Living Close to Nature and Tradition
goal: I can recognize and use the contemplative/leisurely verbal suffix -dogál/-degél/-dögél (üldögél, mendegél, álldogál)
I can convey pastoral calm, slow passage of time, and folktale narrative tone
I can use B2 vocabulary of woodland life, solitude, and contemplative rhythm
